representation.bytes: Same-kind slices retain exact backing bytes. Different buffers use direct byte copying; same-buffer species copies forward, preserving the observable feedback required by slice. It does not use set snapshots or overlap-safe memmove.
representation.writability: The existing shared writable-species validator rejects every immutable destination, including an alias of the source. Removed the same-buffer exception that mutated immutable bytes.
representation.content_type: Species checks derive numeric content from TypedArrayKind::is_bigint, the same kind classification used by set copying.
representation.reduction: Removed duplicate target immutability inspection and the source-alias exception. Kind equality selects raw encoding preservation; different kinds retain shared element conversions. No new side maps, suite changes or unit duplicates.
